efficacy_outcome: Over 3 months, chromium picolinate significantly reduced TG, AIP, VLDL, insulin, HOMA-IR, hs-CRP, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and fetuin-A versus placebo (p<0.05), and increased QUICKI. No significant between-group differences were reported for TC, HDL, LDL, FBS, HbA1c, or IL-17; liver steatosis intensity was unchanged.
